title: A Deadly Party
summary: A man is found shot dead at a party. The team look for a criminal who has seemingly vanished from the island.
method: There were 3 killers, who established each others' alibi. One killed the victim with a silencer, one shot the gun without the silencer at a different time to fake the time of death, and one drove a car away from the scene.
motive: The killers wanted the money that the victim defrauded from victims through a Ponzi scheme.
killer: The secretary, gardener, and a part-time worker
notes:
This is effectively Richard's last episode as DI, although viewers wouldn't know it yet. It's a very sentimental send-off for him. He has to accompany the killer back to England for questioning and promises to return in a few days. The team waits in anticipation, not knowing if he will return, and he actually comes back at the end.
Fidel passes his sergeant exam.
The dynamic between Richard and Camille is the best in the series. There are scenes where Richard isn't supportive enough of Fidel and Camille just has to give him a look before he changes his attitude and says something encouraging.
